common.title: Monthly availability
common.description: The system shall be available for 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance notified 48 hours in advance and carried out between 22:00 and 06:00 IST.
acceptance: Given one calendar month of monitoring data, when availability is computed excluding notified maintenance windows, then it is at least 99.5%.

common.title: Response time at peak concurrency
common.description: The system shall return 95% of page and API responses within 3 seconds with 2,000 concurrent users, measured at the application server.
acceptance: Given a load test with 2,000 concurrent virtual users over 30 minutes, when response times are measured, then the 95th percentile is 3 seconds or less.

common.title: GIGW 3.0 and WCAG 2.1 AA conformance
common.description: The system shall conform to GIGW 3.0 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA for all citizen-facing and departmental screens.
acceptance: Given the GIGW 3.0 compliance checklist, when an STQC or empanelled auditor tests the application, then no non-conformance remains open at go-live.

common.title: Bilingual user interface
common.description: The system shall provide every citizen-facing screen, message and notification in Hindi and English, with the language selectable on every page.
acceptance: Given any citizen-facing screen, when the user switches language, then all labels, help text and validation messages appear in the selected language.

common.title: Audit trail
common.description: The system shall record for every create, update, approve, reject and export action the user ID, role, date and time, IP address, and the values before and after the change, and shall not allow audit records to be edited or deleted.
acceptance: Given an officer approves an application, when the audit log is queried, then an entry shows the officer ID, role, timestamp, IP address and the status before and after.
Given any user, when an attempt is made to modify an audit record, then the attempt is refused and itself logged.

common.title: Aadhaar masking and Data Vault
common.description: The system shall store the Aadhaar number only in an Aadhaar Data Vault, keep only a reference token in application tables, and display only the last four digits on every screen, report and export.
acceptance: Given a saved application, when the database tables outside the vault are inspected, then no full Aadhaar number is present.
Given any screen or report showing Aadhaar, when it is rendered, then only the last four digits are visible.

common.title: Personal data notice, consent, retention and erasure
common.description: The system shall display a notice stating the purpose of processing before collecting personal data, record the applicant's consent with timestamp, retain personal data only for the period notified by the department, and erase or anonymise it thereafter.
acceptance: Given a new applicant, when the application form is opened, then the privacy notice is shown and consent must be recorded before submission.
Given records past the notified retention period, when the retention job runs, then personal data fields are erased or anonymised and the action is logged.

common.title: Backup, RPO and RTO
common.description: The system shall take daily full and hourly incremental backups, with a recovery point objective of 1 hour and a recovery time objective of 4 hours, and a disaster recovery site in a different seismic zone.
acceptance: Given a quarterly DR drill, when the primary site is made unavailable, then service is restored at the DR site within 4 hours with data loss of no more than 1 hour.

common.title: CERT-In incident reporting and log retention
common.description: The system shall retain ICT system logs for 180 days within India, synchronise clocks with NIC or NPL NTP servers, and support reporting of cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of detection.
acceptance: Given logs older than 179 days, when queried, then they are available.
Given a simulated incident, when the incident procedure is run, then a report is prepared for CERT-In within 6 hours.

common.title: Security audit before go-live
common.description: The system shall obtain a safe-to-host certificate from a CERT-In empanelled auditor after closure of all high and medium findings before go-live and after every major release.
acceptance: Given the go-live date, when the release checklist is reviewed, then a valid safe-to-host certificate is on record.

common.title: Hosting in India
common.description: The system shall be hosted in the Rajyapradesh State Data Centre or a MeitY empanelled cloud, with all data and backups stored within India.
acceptance: Given the deployment architecture, when reviewed, then all compute, storage and backup locations are within India.

benefit.title: Right to Service timeline tracking
benefit.description: The system shall compute, for every application, the working days elapsed against the notified Right to Service timeline, excluding days pending with the applicant, and display it to officers and the applicant.
acceptance: Given an application submitted on a working day, when 20 working days have elapsed, then the officer dashboard shows 20 of the notified days consumed.

benefit.title: DBT reconciliation
benefit.description: The system shall reconcile every PFMS payment status daily and show paid, failed and pending counts per district.
acceptance: Given PFMS status files for a day, when reconciliation runs, then every payment record has a status matching PFMS.

permit.title: Right to Service timeline tracking
permit.description: The system shall compute working days elapsed against the notified timeline for each permit application and deem approval where the Act provides for it.
acceptance: Given an application pending beyond the notified timeline, when the daily job runs, then it is flagged and escalated.

licence.title: Right to Service timeline tracking
licence.description: The system shall track notified timelines for licence issue and renewal.
acceptance: Given a renewal application, when the notified timeline is crossed, then it is escalated.
